name: CHANGE OF NUMBERS
clue: To avoid clashing with Leon Uris' 'Mila 18,' Joseph Heller's 1961 novel swapped the 18 in its title for this

name: WHAT'S IN A NO-NAME?
clue: Odysseus gave this fake name, so when the blinded Polyphemus howled for help, the other Cyclopes thought nothing was wrong

name: THE GIFT THAT NEVER GROWS UP
clue: In 1929 J.M. Barrie gave the rights to this play to London's Great Ormond Street Hospital for Children

name: X MARKS THE START
clue: A map Robert Louis Stevenson drew to amuse his stepson on a rainy Scottish holiday grew into this 1883 novel
